what: fal's three answers to one move of minimax-h3 and of gemini-omni-flash-1.2, in the shape Fal.run returns them and a take's sidecar keeps them under "response"
text-to-video: recorded, not here. The paid screen test of 2026-11-16 filmed keys, and recorded/<model>/ holds one key's answers of each model, as recorded/recorded.txt says
image-to-video: <model>-image-to-video.json, a move
source: not recorded. The screen test films no move, and no other paid run filmed one on these models. Each result follows the model's output schema on fal (H3ImageToVideoOutput and Gemini Omni Flash 1.2's), read 2026-11-15 from fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<endpoint>: a video with url, content_type, file_name and file_size, and for H3 an expanded_prompt. Neither schema has duration or seed. The recorded key answers of 2026-11-16 have the same shape. submitted and status copy wan3.0's recorded answers, with each model's queue path. The ids and urls are made up.
size: no recorded answer names it. minimax-h3 at 768P 16:9 draws 1344x768 (VTR-Bench ran H3 at that size), so the tests serve it 1344x768 clips. gemini-omni-flash-1.2's 720p 16:9 size is not stated anywhere read; the tests serve it 1280x720.
